### Del Monte Proudly Announces Sponsorship of American Diabetes Association's Step Out Walk in Pittsburgh


September 22, 2026


Leading producer, distributor and marketer of fresh and shelf-stable food products steps forward with local community to help advance the fight against diabetes, October 11


PITTSBURGH--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Del Monte Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.delmonte.com%2F&esheet=54608253&newsitemid=20260922866395&lan=en-US&anchor=Del+Monte+Corporation&index=1&md5=be0f10db18bd16cad27856ad3a14e907) , one of the world's leading vertically integrated producers, distributors and marketers of fresh and shelf-stable produce, today announced its sponsorship of the American Diabetes Association's (ADA) annual[Step Out® Walk](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fstepout.diabetes.org%2F749&esheet=54608253&newsitemid=20260922866395&lan=en-US&anchor=Step+Out%26%23174%3B+Walk&index=2&md5=dddfc0540ea8f49cf61b2753bc3b3c45) in Pittsburgh on September 26 at PNC Park, joining community members, advocates, healthcare professionals and families in the fight to prevent and cure diabetes while improving the lives of everyone affected by the disease. The partnership reflects Del Monte's continued commitment to strengthening its presence in the Steel City—a community where its North American Foods Division has called home for more than two decades.


“We believe in investing in the health and well-being of the communities we serve, and it’s especially meaningful to engage in the local Pittsburgh community, where our foods division is based,” said Michael Buesink, VP. “We are honored to support the ADA Step Out Walk and walk with fellow teammates alongside individuals and families impacted by diabetes.”


“With the generous support of valuable corporate sponsors like Del Monte Foods, our Step Out Walk: Pittsburgh has the opportunity to be the largest ADA walk in history, and potential to be the first to raise $1MM to support the ADA,” comments Chelesa Musial, ADA Executive Director, Western PA & Eastern OH. “Del Monte's support will help advance diabetes research, provide educational resources, and promote advocacy initiatives that drive meaningful change for millions of Americans living with diabetes.”


Del Monte[recently reaffirmed Pittsburgh](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.businesswire.com%2Fnews%2Fhome%2F20260507424875%2Fen%2FFresh-Del-Monte-Names-Pittsburgh-as-New-Hub-for-Foods-Division&esheet=54608253&newsitemid=20260922866395&lan=en-US&anchor=recently+reaffirmed+Pittsburgh&index=3&md5=8a05a214bd0a8a0e624ded741c4508f7) as the operational hub for its Foods Division, where key functions including supply chain, finance, commercial operations and research and development are anchored. The company’s history in Pittsburgh dates back to 2002, when the company acquired several iconic brands, including StarKist, 9Lives and Nature's Goodness, from Heinz. More than two decades later, the Foods Division continues to expand its presence in the region while building partnerships, including the Pittsburgh Pirates and others, that celebrate Pittsburgh's culture, community and future.


**About Del Monte Corporation**


[Del Monte Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdelmontecorporation.com%2F&esheet=54608253&newsitemid=20260922866395&lan=en-US&anchor=Del+Monte+Corporation&index=4&md5=067ee009645610da9b1f96d2a6730ac8) (NYSE: DMC) is one of the world's leading vertically integrated producers, distributors and marketers of fresh and shelf-stable food products, with products sold in more than 90 countries worldwide. As the global owner of the Del Monte® brand, subject to certain existing licensing arrangements, the company operates across fresh produce, fresh-cut fruit and vegetables, refrigerated foods and shelf-stable categories, serving consumers around the world with a portfolio built on quality, innovation and trust.


Formerly Fresh Del Monte Produce Inc., the company changed its corporate name to Del Monte Corporation in June 2026, reflecting its expanded role as steward of one of the world's most recognized food brands and its commitment to unlocking new opportunities for growth, innovation and global brand expansion.


The Del Monte® brand has been a symbol of quality, freshness and reliability for more than 135 years and is the No. 1 canned vegetable brand in the United States, according to Circana1. Del Monte Corporation is not affiliated with certain other Del Monte companies around the world, including Del Monte Asia Pte. Ltd. The company is the first global marketer of fruits and vegetables to commit to the Science Based Targets initiative and has been recognized as one of America's Most Trusted Companies by Newsweek and named a Humankind 100 Company by Humankind Investments.


Del Monte Corporation is traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol DMC.


1 Circana, Canned Vegetables, Total U.S., Last 52 Weeks Ending Aug. 2, 2026, based on dollar sales.
